title: Contribute to our Survey
bodyHtml: PanKbase is an in-development resource that will serve as a central hub for the pancreas and diabetes research communities. As we develop PanKbase, we need your input to ensure that it meets the needs of diverse investigators. Please share your thoughts by completing this brief survey.
summary: As we develop PanKbase,  we want to hear from our users and community. Please share your thoughts by completing our brief survey.
